name: read_tmp_file
description: Read a scratch file under /tmp/cerisier/ (written by write_tmp_file). Replaces shell file reading for scratch files, so never use run_command for it: `cat f` -> name only; `sed -n 'N,Mp' f` -> start_line=N, end_line=M; `head -n N f` -> end_line=N; `tail -n N f` -> read the file, or use search_files to find the line you need and request that range; `cat -n f` -> line_numbers=true; `head -c N f` / `tail -c +N f` -> length / offset (bytes). Line ranges are 1-based and inclusive. Names that escape /tmp/cerisier/ are rejected; runs without approval.

name.description: File name relative to /tmp/cerisier/, e.g. "scan.py" or "job1/out.txt".

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (default 0).

length.description: Max bytes to read (default and cap 1048576).

line_numbers.description: Prefix each returned line with its 1-based line number (default false).

start_line.description: First line to return, 1-based (like sed -n 'N,Mp'). Overrides offset/length.

end_line.description: Last line to return, inclusive (default end of file).
